# Accounting for Ledger Engineers

> A course on double-entry accounting for software engineers who build ledgers, plus a Sandbox: a double-entry
> workbench where you model entities (each with its own chart of accounts) and scenarios made of events, each
> booked as a journal entry in every entity it touches. The Sandbox imports and exports a JSON file; an agent can
> write one by hand and the user opens it with ⋯ Sandbox menu → Import.

## Sandbox files

- [Sandbox file format](sandbox-format.md): every field, the conventions (amounts in cents, dr/cr, events shared
  across entities, "none" for no entry), the checks the Sandbox runs, and tips for modelling.
- [JSON Schema](sandbox.schema.json): the file's schema (draft 2020-12), generated from the app's validator.
- [Example file](sandbox-example.json): a complete, valid Sandbox file — a coffee cart and its bank.
